subject: Competitive pricing request & migration plan - Sunvale Systems
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@sunvale.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sunvale.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing gap vs. incumbent + request for migration plan

Jordan —

Thanks for the overview last week. We received a final pricing sheet from one of your competitors (note attached). They are proposing a three-year committed arrangement that undercuts your list by about 28% for similar throughput and offers a migration assistance credit.

Before we escalate to budget sign-off, procurement asked whether Redwood can:
- provide a price match or alternative packaging that brings effective TCO within ~10% of the competitor,
- outline a realistic vendor-replacement migration plan (data egress, minimal downtime, model parity checks), and
- confirm any constraints on audit logs / retention and SOC2 evidence for the proposed discount structure.

We're targeting an internal procurement decision by 2026-04-25. Can you share an updated commercial that addresses the above?

Best,
Samantha Cole
Head of Platform Ops, Sunvale Systems
[Attachment: Competitor_Final_Offer.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@sunvale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing gap vs. incumbent + request for migration plan

Samantha —

Appreciate the transparency and the timeline. Short answer: we can get you closer on TCO and we have a documented migration playbook. I'll loop in Marissa (your AE) for commercial flexibility and Diego for the migration specifics.

High level commitments we can put on the table for procurement review:
- Commercial: a 12- or 36-month committed tier with blended discounts tied to throughput and retention SLAs; potential one-time migration credit (amount TBD once we see exact throughput).
- Migration: a phased cutover approach (shadow traffic -> incremental cutover -> final switch) plus a 4-week runbook validated by our SEs; model output parity checks included.
- Compliance: we can provide SOC 2 Type II artifacts and an audit-log export format; any additional retention can be accommodated under a contract addendum.

Marissa/Diego — can you prepare: (1) a competitor-compare workbook with recomputed TCO (please include token assumptions and average seq length), (2) a proposed discount schedule and any gating conditions, and (3) an editable migration timeline with milestones and responsible owners? Samantha — we'll aim to send that package by EOD tomorrow (2026-04-16).

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: request_log.txt (txt) — internal note]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@sunvale.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing gap vs. incumbent + request for migration plan

Team —

I've run a few quick scenarios in the attached workbook (Sunvale_RFP_Comparison.xlsx). Key notes:
- The competitor's sheet assumes 35% higher average sequence length and no KV cache optimization; once you apply realistic KV cache and batching we reduce token consumption by ~18% in our model.
- Commercial proposal options:
  * Option A (12-month): 15% list discount + migration credit of up to $40k for engineering hours; no change to audit deliverables.
  * Option B (36-month): 25% list discount + $90k migration credit + guaranteed price cap for 24 months.
  * Option C (Migration-first): short pilot with 3-month committed uplift; if pilot proves out, convert to 24-month commit at 22% discount.
- Conditions: discounts are conditioned on committed throughput tiers and a mutually agreed runbook; large migration credits require a signed SOW.

Diego — can you attach the migration timeline doc with estimated engineer-days and a brief note on model parity checkpoints? Samantha — which of these options would you prefer we cost out in a formal redline?

—Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Sunvale_RFP_Comparison.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@sunvale.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing gap vs. incumbent + request for migration plan

Jordan / Marissa / Samantha —

Uploading the migration timeline and SOW stub — attached. Highlights:
- Phased plan (estimated calendar weeks):
  1) Discovery & infra prep (1–2 weeks)
  2) Shadow traffic + parity checks (2–3 weeks)
  3) Incremental cutover (1 week)
  4) Post-cutover support (4 weeks)
- Risk items: egress volume (we recommend staged egress to avoid large bills), compatibility with existing monitoring (we provide exporters and tracing hooks), and model artifact handoff.
- Team: 1 SE lead + 2 infra engineers + 1 PM for coordination; estimated 6–8 engineer-weeks for full replacement.

Attachment: Migration_Timeline_SLAs.docx

Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@sunvale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@sunvale.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing gap vs. incumbent + request for migration plan

Samantha / Procurement team —

Thanks for patience while we pulled this together. Attached is a concise commercial package and migration playbook: Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_v2.pdf, Sunvale_RFP_Comparison.xlsx, Migration_Timeline_SLAs.docx. Summary of our recommended path:

- Offer: Option B (36-month) brings effective TCO within ~6–8% of the competitor when factoring in our cache/batching and the $90k migration credit. We can also do a 24-month price cap for year 1–2.
- Conditions: signed MSA + SOW (SOW will include migration credit amortization and success criteria), committed throughput tiers, and standard audit addendum for extended log retention.
- Migration: proposed phased plan with a two-week shadow period to validate parity; final cutover scheduled for a weekend with our on-call SEs. Estimated total 6–8 engineer-weeks.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement confirms preferred commercial option (A/B/C) by 2026-04-20.
2) Marissa to produce a redlined commercial and draft SOW for signature.
3) Diego to schedule a 60‑minute runbook review with Sunvale infra team (suggest Wed 21 Apr).

If procurement needs a deeper price-match (i.e., match total three-year net to competitor) we have limited headroom but can explore a conditional top-up credit tied to measured token usage after cutover.

Appreciate you sharing the competitor packet — that made crafting a tight response possible.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_v2.pdf (pdf); Sunvale_RFP_Comparison.xlsx (xlsx); Migration_Timeline_SLAs.docx (docx)]
